rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: val_n=214, rationale=iter-12 TRAIN THE PROVEN iter-7 unroll BETTER (trainer rewrite, ZERO new params, model byte-for-byte iter-7). iter-7 CHAMPION (foe nf24/k7/nb31 1921p, K=5 tied prox+DC, scalar alpha, no momentum/per-step-alpha/learned-init, cosine 5e-3->1e-5, 16ep) was TRAIN-CUT at ~ep8 by the 1080s wall with loss STILL falling monotonically (3.4e-6->7.1e-7, NO oscillation): genuinely UNDER-trained (train~=val MSE, not overfit). FAILURE MODE: every attempt to ADD to the unroll (iter-8 capacity nf40 diverged psnr1.87; iter-9 K=7 diverged; iter-10 AND iter-11 learned-init BOTH froze at loss 1.9e-4 even with VERIFIED true zero-init) -> the only proven-stable thing is the iter-7 unroll itself, and it is undertrained. CHANGE (TRAINER ONLY): peak cosine LR 5e-3->1e-2 (2x) + 0.5-epoch LINEAR WARMUP (0->peak over ~100 batches) + Adam->AdamW wd 1e-4. learned_init=False so model is iter-7 byte-for-byte. STABILITY: iter-7 loss monotone+no-oscillation = under-aggressive step with headroom before the stability edge; warmup removes the destructive first-step overshoot (the mechanism that froze iter-10/11); grad_clip=1.0 caps spikes; recon dynamics (K=5, scalar alpha, plain prox, zero-init FoE) untouched. params==1921 unchanged. cosine tail eta_min=1e-5 unchanged so late steps gentle. Wall == iter-7 (~1331s, trainer adds zero per-step compute). HYPOTHESIS: faster descent reaches lower val-RMSE in the same ~8 budget-epochs -> hr ABOVE 0.2515. If it MATCHES, the 8-ep run is loss-saturated not step-limited; if it REGRESSES, 2x peak exceeded the stable step even with warmup (revert to 8e-3). PREDICTED hr ~0.27-0.31., reg_type=foe, n_iter=5, learnable_alpha=True, per_step_alpha=False, momentum=False, cnn_channels=12, cnn_layers=3, alpha_init=0.1, clip_max=0.05, epochs=16, cosine_lr=True, cosine_lr_min=1e-05, lr=0.01, max_train_s=1080, train_n=200, foe_n_filters=24, foe_kernel=7, foe_n_bumps=31, foe_rbf_init_std=0.0, foe_filter_init_std=0.05, foe_x_range=1.0, warmup_frac=0.5, weight_decay=0.0001, learned_init=False
